title: The link from the √13 wall to compactness is an open conjecture

statements.text: The Yang-Mills paper separates the cases: compactness of the manifold, not the arithmetic of $K$, gives the discrete spectrum, and the chain from the $\sqrt{13}$ wall to a finite lattice to a compact manifold is a flagged conjecture, not a lemma. The cascade is a structural resonance, not a derivation.

sources.quote: the cascade is a structural resonance, not a derivation
